evals.name: hero-image-landscape-routing
evals.prompt: im putting together a landing page for a japanese tea subscription thing im working on. can you generate me a hero image with qwen? save it into ./assets/ . needs to feel calm and premium, and leave the left side fairly empty because the headline goes there
evals.expected_output: A landscape PNG in ./assets/, rendered through scripts/qwenimage.py with an explicit --size in a landscape ratio, from a prompt written to a file rather than passed inline.
assertions: Output is a valid PNG at least 1000px wide
Rendered through the bundled qwenimage.py script (log written)
Passed an explicit --size instead of letting the model choose
Chose a landscape ratio, matching a hero with headline space
Prompt was written to a file rather than passed inline
Prompt is a fully specified brief of 60+ words

evals.name: cjk-text-poster
evals.prompt: i need a small poster image with the japanese words 秋の味 actually printed on it, autumn colours, kind of a minimal japanese grocery ad look. use qwen for this one. drop it at ./posters/aki.png
evals.expected_output: A PNG at ./posters/aki.png produced by scripts/qwenimage.py using qwen-image-3.0-pro, with the exact string quoted in the prompt and prompt_extend disabled so the typography spec survives.
assertions: Wrote a PNG at the exact requested path ./posters/aki.png
Rendered through the bundled qwenimage.py script (log written)
Used qwen-image-3.0-pro, the family's strongest text renderer
Quoted the exact string 秋の味 in the prompt
Disabled prompt_extend so the typography spec survives
Prompt is a fully specified brief of 60+ words

evals.name: edit-preserves-input-size
evals.prompt: the product shot at ./input/product-shot.png has a wooden table background, i want it on a plain white seamless studio backdrop instead. everything else about the shot should stay exactly the same. use qwen image for it, save as ./input/product-shot-white.png
evals.expected_output: A PNG at ./input/product-shot-white.png produced by the edit command with --size matching the 1664x928 input, so the framing is preserved rather than the model upscaling and recomposing.
assertions: Wrote a PNG at the exact requested path ./input/product-shot-white.png
Rendered through the bundled qwenimage.py script (log written)
Used the edit command rather than rerolling with generate
Passed the existing file as an input image
Passed an explicit --size instead of letting the model choose
Output keeps the input's exact 1664x928 framing (no silent upscale)
